parameters.content:
BGG does not publish a write API. Setting own/fortrade/rating/comment on your BGG collection from automation means driving BGG's logged-in website, which is undocumented and can break at any time.

If you want to pursue this yourself:
1. Log into boardgamegeek.com in a normal browser.
2. Capture your session cookie (DevTools > Application > Cookies).
3. Store it as an n8n credential (e.g. HTTP Header Auth with a Cookie header) — never paste it into chat with an AI assistant.
4. Replace the HTTP Request node below with a call to BGG's actual collection-edit endpoint, which you'll need to find via your browser's network tab while editing your collection manually, and verify yourself.

This workflow intentionally stops short of that and just returns not_implemented, so your frontend has a stable endpoint to call without breaking.
